about: The decomposition a planner would naturally arrive at for bench/fixture-long/brief.md: one issue per row. It is NOT given to any arm; test/test_bench_long.py checks that its size (6-8), that every issue edits the one shared module and that nothing needs anything else stay what the fixture claims. The issues are independent on purpose: they all edit tabula/engine.py, so the lanes contend for it and each one reads a module that keeps growing.
